text:
lauren: heads up — noticed a spike in "duplicate_session" counts when clients rapidly reconnect (mobile clients w/ flaky LTE). console shows two active sessions for same resume_token for ~15s :thinking_face:

sam: can you paste the raw trace or a sample request? is resume_token reused or a new one issued each reconnect?

lauren: sample from edge logs: `SESSION_RESUME token=abc123 client_id=mobile-47`, then immediately `SESSION_START token=abc123 client_id=mobile-47` and both are marked active. trace id 01F8ZJ

aj: that sounds like a race in the resume verification + route-claim. We check token validity, then route, but we only mark previous session closed on heartbeat timeout later.

lauren: repro steps: 1) start streaming, 2) disable network for 200ms, 3) reconnect -> sometimes two sessions show up in the dashboard and billing increments twice.

kevin: @aj could this be due to route swap + laggy tombstone propagation between route managers? I remember a similar window where route claim is async.

aj: yeah possible. Current flow: resume request -> check token store -> claim route -> emit start event. We rely on async tombstone propagation to clear old leases. If old session is still in routing layer, both endpoints consider themselves active.

irina: from the console POV this looks really bad. Users see duplicate live sessions and cost spikes. We should add a short-lived server-side dedupe by resume_token while we fix routing. e.g., treat duplicate starts within 5s as idempotent and suppress billing event.

sam: agree. quick mitigation: in meter pipeline, add a dedupe window keyed by resume_token for 10s. That buys time and is low-risk. I'll open an infra ticket.

lauren: also noticed resume_token TTL is 60s. for mobile smooshing reconnects maybe extend to 120s? but that might hide real stale tokens.

aj: prefer not to extend TTL globally. instead implement a fast atomic lease check when resume arrives: attempt to atomically swap session_id in token store. if swap fails and the previous session reports live recently (heartbeat <2s), reject or instruct client to wait and then resume.

kevin: atomic swap needs support from our token store (Redis CAS). We have it but must ensure this operation is done in the hot path without adding >1ms latency.

irina: short-term: dedupe in billing + annotation in console that shows "overlapping resume events" with trace link. product wants a banner on tenant page if this happens >5 times in 1hr.

sam: created infra ticket INF-1249 (dedupe window pipeline) and linked a quick patch for the meter that tags suppressed events with `dedupe:true` — deploy bot will run canary.

dev-bot: deploy started by sam at 2026-03-22T15:21:00Z — canary to 2 hosts in eu-west-1

aj: for long-term we should: 1) implement atomic resume lease swap, 2) surface join/leave event stream to console with exact wall times, 3) add route-manager tombstone propagation healthcheck metric.

lauren: thanks — I'll paste the exact client repro script below. cc @kevin for route-manager metrics.

lauren: ```bash
# repro script (ws)
for i in {1..10}; do
  node reconnect-test.js --down 200ms && sleep 0.1
done
```

kevin: got it, will add tombstone lag histogram and an alert when p50 > 50ms.

sam: rolling canary now, please watch console for suppressed billing tags and any restart-induced anomalies.

lauren: noted — will monitor and report back with screenshots if it recurs. :thumbsup:
